text:
maria.chen: Heads-up: noticed p99 on 'endpoint:/v1/generate' jump from ~180ms -> ~540ms after the route-weight rollout. Aggregated chart looks smaller than the per-endpoint slice. Anyone else seeing a mismatch? likely sampling issue? :eyes:

jonathan: Saw it. Aggregated rollups use tdigest with sampling=1% for high-card slices; endpoint slices use full sampling. If route weights changed, the small-sample rollups can under-represent the tail.

alim: Confirming — rollout moved canary 10%->50% yesterday. Our rollup config `merge_mode: approximate` does uniform downsampling before tdigest. That biases p99 when latency is multimodal.

tara: We need the console to surface sample-rate + merge_mode. Right now charts don't show whether p99 is from full-sample or a rolled-up downsample. UX idea: per-timeseries badge `sample=1% / merge=approx` and a tooltip with `per-slice sample`.

maria.chen: Short-term: can we enable `preserve_tail=true` for this endpoint rollup in backend? How disruptive is that?

jonathan: We can flip `preserve_tail` per-route but it increases t-digest memory ~3x. Requires patch in aggregation service + config deploy. ETA ~2–3 hrs to push and validate. Alternative: backfill 24h window with preserve_tail on historical data.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out config patch `agg/preserve-tail` to staging at 2123456798 by jonathan — status: success

alim: Also noting routing policy had a fallback to cheaper variant `gpt-lite` for ~5% of requests during the rollout. That creates a bi-modal latency distribution and exaggerates p99. If rollouts don't annotate model-variant we end up mixing signals.

tara: Filed GH issue for console: "show sampling & model_variant annotations on latency graphs" — https://github.com/redwood/console/issues/4829 :thumbsup:

maria.chen: Thanks all. Can someone add a short note in console docs about how tdigest rollups and sampling affect percentiles? I'll ping ops once preserve_tail is live and check p99 on the endpoint slice.
